tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Full-text search of the Camden Tools catalogue (hand tools, power tools, accessories, safety equipment). Returns compact products with prices ex/inc VAT, stock and a link. Use page/per_page to paginate and brand/min_price/max_price to narrow down.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Browse a product collection: most popular, newest, on sale, Website Express eligible, or a category by slug (see list_categories). Supports paging, sorting and brand/price filters.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details for one product by slug, SKU or id: description, specifications, prices ex/inc VAT with bulk breaks, stock, variants, safety/spec documents and the canonical page URL. Provide exactly one of slug, sku or id.

tools.name: get_products
tools.description: Look up up to 50 products at once by SKU or by numeric id. Returns compact products (name, price ex/inc VAT, stock, link).

tools.name: get_stock_level
tools.description: Live availability check for a SKU (is it available now and how many are in the London warehouse).

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2 to 5 products by SKU: price ex/inc VAT, stock, brand, weight and the specification bullet points, so an agent can recommend between options.

tools.name: get_related_products
tools.description: Variants, similar products, recommendations and 'you may also like' items for a product (by slug or SKU). Useful for alternatives when something is out of stock.

tools.name: get_product_documents
tools.description: Safety data sheets, specification sheets and COSHH hazard codes for a product (by slug or SKU). Returns document URLs.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Product categories with slugs and links. Use popular_only for the curated set shown on the site; otherwise the full list.

tools.name: get_category
tools.description: A category's name, description and its products (paged) by category slug.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: Brands sold by Camden Tools (DeWalt, Makita, Milwaukee, Bosch, Stanley …). Without a query returns the popular brands; with a query searches brand names.

tools.name: get_brand_products
tools.description: A brand's details, its active promotions and its products (paged) by brand slug.

tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: Current storefront promotions (percentage/fixed discounts and free gifts), optionally grouped by brand or category. Also points at the /offers page.

tools.name: get_product_promotions
tools.description: Active promotions that apply to one SKU (discounts, free gifts, end dates).

tools.name: list_bundles
tools.description: Curated product bundles (kits) with their items and prices.

tools.name: get_cart_promotions
tools.description: Evaluate a prospective basket for a destination country: whether it can be fulfilled, which promotions apply (including free-delivery style offers and free gifts) and the adjusted basket value. Same check the checkout runs.

tools.name: get_express_delivery_status
tools.description: Whether Website Express (free same-working-day dispatch for eligible UK orders) is available right now, the order-by cutoff and the promised dispatch date.

tools.name: check_express_eligibility
tools.description: Whole-basket Website Express verdict for a set of product ids and quantities: every line must be eligible (no split shipments).

tools.name: check_shipping_availability
tools.description: Whether Camden Tools ships to a country, with any restriction message.

tools.name: get_prices_for_country
tools.description: Country-specific pricing for a set of products (the checkout applies the destination country's currency and pricing). Returns unit, sale and final prices plus the subtotal.

tools.name: estimate_delivery
tools.description: Delivery services, charges and transit times for a basket to a destination (country plus postcode/ZIP and city). This is an estimate using placeholder contact details; exact rates are confirmed at checkout.

tools.name: lookup_uk_postcode
tools.description: Addresses for a UK postcode (rate limited upstream). Returns matching addresses or suggestions when the postcode is incomplete.

tools.name: create_basket_link
tools.description: Turn product ids and quantities into one link that fills the shopper's basket on camdentools.com. Opening the link makes sure the basket holds at least those quantities (opening it twice does not double them); the shopper reviews the basket and pays at checkout themselves. The result says which line

tools.name: track_guest_order
tools.description: Order status, tracking number/URL, shipping method and line items for any order, given the order number and the delivery postcode (no sign-in needed).

tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: Who Camden Tools is, how to contact them, VAT display rules, key page links, current announcements and a summary of each policy (delivery, returns, payment, FAQs). Call get_policy for the full text of a policy.

tools.name: get_policy
tools.description: Full text (markdown) of a store policy: delivery, returns, payment-options, faqs or contact.

tools.name: get_collection_point_info
tools.description: The London Click & Collect warehouse: address, opening hours, whether it is open right now (Europe/London, bank holidays respected) and when it next opens.

tools.name: search_blog_posts
tools.description: Guides and articles from the Camden Tools blog (how-tos, buying guides, brand news).

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: A blog post's full text (plain text) by slug.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product, get_product_documents, check_shipping_availability, search_blog_posts, get_blog_post · Private data: get_product, get_product_documents, estimate_delivery, get_site_info, get_policy · Public sink: get_blog_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product, get_product_documents, check_shipping_availability, search_blog_posts, get_blog_post · Private data: get_product, get_product_documents, estimate_delivery, get_site_info, get_policy · Public sink: get_blog_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
